totp.title: Two-factor authentication
totp.description: Set up or turn off the authenticator app
totp.text: After your password or e-mail code we also ask for a code from your authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy). Passkeys are enough on their own.
totp.disableText: Your account is then only protected by your password or e-mail code.
totp.step1: Add your account to your authenticator app.
totp.scan: Scan the code with the authenticator app on your phone.
totp.qrLabel: QR code for the authenticator app
totp.manual: Or enter this key by hand:
totp.step2: Enter the 6-digit code from the app.
totp.codesText: They get you into your account if you lose your phone. Each code works once. We only show them now.
totp.recoveryFileTitle: Recovery codes – each code works only once.
